lay_summary: Scientists build tiny genetic switches in bacteria, and one idea says you can change how easily a switch flips without changing how sharply it flips.
We tested that idea on a public parts list and it mostly held, but one pair of switches changed sharpness more than the limit we had set, so the honest score is a fail.
For the bacteria-spreading project, we confirmed that the two maths rules it needs are already in the project's rule book.
One project still needs someone to redo an earlier calculation, which we did not have time for.
The last two need real objects to be 3D-printed and weighed or measured, which only a person in a lab can do.

glossary.RBS (ribosome binding site): A short stretch of DNA that sets how much protein a gene makes.
glossary.Repressor: A protein that switches another gene off.
glossary.Hill coefficient (n): A number for how sharply a genetic switch flips from on to off.
glossary.Threshold (K): The input level at which the switch is half flipped.
glossary.Steepness drift (dn): How much the sharpness number differs between two switches, as a fraction of their average.
glossary.UCF: User constraints file: the public Cello parts list with measured switch numbers.
glossary.sha256: A digital fingerprint that proves a file is exactly the one that was downloaded.
glossary.Frozen bound / pre-registration: A limit or prediction written down before looking at the test data.
glossary.Declared-not-blind: A test where the answer had already been seen, said openly.
glossary.Lean theorem: A maths statement checked by a computer proof program.
glossary.Law set: The project's versioned list of rules, here version 1.8.1.
glossary.Candidate: A rule that has a checked statement but is not yet fully accepted.
glossary.Vertex model: A computer model that draws cells as polygons to predict tissue shape.
glossary.RMSE: A single number for how far predictions are from measurements on average.
glossary.Autorotating fruit: A winged seed that spins as it falls.
glossary.Immersed weight: How heavy an object is while under water.
glossary.Swelling strain: The fraction by which a material grows when it soaks up water.
glossary.Bilayer: A strip of two bonded layers that bends when one layer swells more.
glossary.Coupon: A small test piece of a material.
